# Recorded answers of the Baza Konkurencyjności

Source: Baza Konkurencyjności Funduszy Europejskich, run by the Ministry of
Funds and Regional Policy (Ministerstwo Funduszy i Polityki Regionalnej),
<https://bazakonkurencyjnosci.funduszeeuropejskie.gov.pl/>.

Obtained on 22 November 2026.

The content was processed: every contact person was replaced by one invented
person, the accounts that created or changed a record were blanked, addresses
and phone numbers in free text were replaced, and the search page was cut to
three results. `scripts/record_fixture.py` does this and is the only way these
files are made.

| File | What it is |
|------|------------|
| `search.json` | The first page of open notices under CPV 80500000-9. |
| `notice_297898.json` | A notice with one order, whose conditions all point at attachments. |
| `notice_298002.json` | A notice with three orders and conditions thousands of characters long. |
